title: Home Purchase Financing — Payment Channels, Card Policy and Order of Application
content:
**Cashiering and remittance standard — Hearthstone Home Finance**

Installments and fees on a Home Purchase Financing loan are accepted only through the channels listed for the borrower's program. Card payments are not part of any program.

| Program | Accepted channels | Debit or credit card payments | Payment smaller than one full installment | Order of application | Smallest curtailment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home-Only Loan 7-Year Fixed | ACH autopay; online portal ACH; phone ACH; mailed check; cashier's check at the office; money order at the office | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 10-Year Fixed | same six channels | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 15-Year Fixed | same six channels | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 20-Year Fixed | same six channels | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 23-Year Fixed | same six channels | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |
| Home-Only Loan 25-Year Fixed | same six channels | not accepted | held in suspense | interest, principal, escrow, late charges, other fees | 25.00 |

**Notes to the table**

- *Curtailment.* A curtailment is an extra payment of principal; the smallest accepted is the figure in the last column.
- *Suspense.* A payment smaller than one full installment is not applied to an installment; it is held unapplied in suspense.
- *Order.* A payment is applied to the buckets in the order shown: interest first, then principal, then escrow, then late charges, then other fees.

*Hypothetical examples:* a borrower who offers to pay by debit card is outside every accepted channel; a money order presented at the community office is within them. An extra principal amount of 25.00 meets the smallest curtailment; 24.99 does not.
